notice: First sourced briefing published. Updates are researched hourly; GitHub publication is attempted on each task run and may be delayed or unavailable. Claims attributed to organisers are not independently verified.

events.title: October 10 Jantar Mantar protest announced
events.description: CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke announced plans to protest at Jantar Mantar on October 10, calling for Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar to resign. The demonstration was described as peaceful.
events.context: Confirmed as an announcement, not confirmation that tomorrow's demonstration has begun.

events.title: Delhi Police outlines extensive security arrangements
events.description: The Indian Express reports police preparations including 600 low-floor buses intended to transport detainees, body-worn cameras, and a 23-zone security structure ahead of the planned gathering.
events.context: Details describe the reported police plan; they do not establish how many people will attend or be detained.

events.title: Organisers allege pre-protest mass detentions
events.description: CJP alleges that more than 10,000 members or affiliates have been detained ahead of the demonstration.
events.context: The figure is an organiser claim reported by The Guardian and has not been independently confirmed.

events.title: CJP spokesperson appeals to police ahead of rally
events.description: CJP spokesperson Ashutosh Ranka issued a public message appealing to police not to use force against students at the planned demonstration.
events.context: Verified as a reported statement, not evidence of a confrontation taking place.

events.title: Metro and traffic restrictions reported
events.description: Financial Express reports announced restrictions affecting Delhi Metro access and potential traffic diversions in central Delhi ahead of the planned protest.
events.context: Check Delhi Metro and police's official live travel advisories for real-time operational confirmation.
